newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania truck, bus orders rose in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Scania truck, bus orders rose in Q1.

text.p: Swedish truck maker Scania said on Thursday that orders for trucks and buses rose in the first quarter.
It said in a statement of first quarter results that truck order bookings rose six percent to 11,065 trucks and that bus and coach order bookings were 83 percent higher at 1,317.
Although truck order bookings rose, sales fell by 14 percent to 9,190 units.
"In European operations, sales declined by about 20 percent while in Latin America they rose by about 20 percent," the group said in a statement of first quarter results.

The rise in bus and coach order bookings came with a fall in sales of six percent to 969 units, which included a four percent fall in European operations and a 10 percent drop in Latin America, the group said.
